title: release-codex-plugin

goal.text: Publish a verified Codex plugin release from the committed marketplace source.

requirements.summary: Release only the Codex adapter artifact family without npm publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate preparation allocated the family-specific target version; promotion preserves it unchanged.
The committed marketplace payload and metadata are complete and verified.
The immutable vcodex-<version> tag and GitHub Release identify the complete composed marketplace artifact and its reviewed clean origin/main source revision.
No npm package or plugin ZIP is published.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the Codex release baseline
tasks.detail: Select the authorized tested frozen candidate and verify its artifact family, sourceRevision and trial; absent a candidate, use candidate preparation and stop before publication. Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, manifests, marketplace metadata, and every worktree change. Reject unapproved cross-family changes.

tasks.title: Confirm the frozen candidate version
tasks.detail: Read the chosen frozen candidate and its source manifests; verify the family-specific three/four-segment version, dependencies and npm mapping. Candidate preparation already allocated the number. Do not change versions, dependencies or lockfiles during promotion.

tasks.title: Verify built-in templated skill compatibility
tasks.detail: Review the candidate preparation evidence and, if needed, run the read-only npm run check:template-versions. Do not repair a selected frozen candidate in place; any required source/input repair needs a new candidate version and trial.

tasks.title: Verify the Codex plugin candidate
tasks.detail: Verify the frozen candidate inventory, hashes, exact sourceRevision, prior test evidence and seven-day trial. For DSH use npm run publish:dsh-plugin -- --candidate <directory> in verification-only mode; other families consume their recorded frozen tree through their artifact owner. Do not run workspace builds, package export or repacking. If evidence or content is wrong, prepare a new version rather than modifying this candidate.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and release
tasks.detail: Require matching CLI npm retrieval before any push. Consume only the selected candidate’s unchanged source revision and stored frozen marketplace tree; never use a newly assembled workspace tree or re-export. Publish to the authorized existing immutable vcodex-<candidate-version> artifact ref and GitHub Release, record source and artifact commits separately, compare published files/hash with the candidate, and require clean source main == origin/main at completion. No npm or ZIP publication through this skill.

tasks.title: Verify the immutable Codex release
tasks.detail: Verify tag, release, committed marketplace paths and manifests, and repository cleanliness. If a maintainer installation refresh is separately authorized, first remove every local claw-kit marketplace registration, plugin identity, hook configuration, and cache tree; then refresh only from the published GitHub source, enable claw-kit@claw-kit, and verify its source/cache manifests. Never leave or enable a local claw-kit identity as the normal runtime.

references.why: Owns the Codex plugin release contract.

rules: Formal promotion requires the explicitly selected tested frozen candidate. Preserve its version and hashes; never bump, build, pack or export again. If no tested candidate exists, prepare a new version through beta:prepare and stop before publication.
Never publish npm packages or attach a plugin ZIP.
Never modify another artifact family without explicit batch authority.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
